title: Nutrition, hydration, targets and weight-loss rate
notes: Every number shows a confidence label: High (regulator or major guideline value), Moderate (guideline statement or trial result reported secondhand), Low (expert proposal, secondary source, or a design choice).
Values marked 'computed' are simple arithmetic from the cited numbers (for example a 72-week total divided by 72).
conflicts: Protein: Health Canada RDA 0.8 g/kg vs 1.2-1.6 g/kg proposed during active weight loss (advisory); the advisory itself says actual-weight calculations can overestimate needs.
